cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The model cloud produced one drop. Let's build the welcome tray. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That doesn't prove the full rain machine works.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. It proves the tray has a purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put the small success where we can still see it.

mechanism: A organizes a display of B bottled cloud and supplies watering work while emphasizing one wet leaf over the concealed last-drop warning.
confusable: Unlike ordinary optimism, B names the hidden limiting evidence while A keeps the hoped-for rain project moving with a concrete next test.
comparison: Cloud-invention persistence and seedling care differ from an audio-only time visitor.
seedUse: D159-b one drop and practical display reauthored with explicit bottled cloud, seedlings and hidden label; S02-b takes real support work.
